hindsight.changed_choice: If confirmed settings differ from every approved phase-5 arm, add its one-head reference on seeds 42--61 at all registered points.

tuning.candidate_rule: For each maze and K, pool each measured pilot temperature equally using its final cumulative proposal-variance acceptance curve. For target mean acceptances 3/4, 1/2 and 1/4 choose the nearest integer T in 1..24, ties to smaller T; deduplicate. No success field is read.
tuning.selection: Highest equally weighted checkpoint-mean validation success within each seed, averaged over five seeds; scores within 1e-12 tie to smaller T.
tuning.budgets: the registered final budgets and nominal points

final_grid.temperature: the selected T separately for every retained maze and K; controls zero

references.rule: reuse verified approved archives; never rerun

analysis.seed_unit: seed, averaging heads inside the seed
analysis.summaries: mean and SE over twenty seeds
analysis.paired_interval: marginal 95% Student t(19), critical value 2.093024054408263, without multiplicity correction
analysis.threshold_rule: First registered nominal point reaching each exact archived final-mean test threshold. Recover integer counts per head, divide by heads*test pairs, and use Fraction for seed means and comparisons; no interpolation.

execution.guards: clean frozen musl measurement, mechanical manifests before sbatch, grant and test-only before each submission, node guards and STOP; no lease, host pinning or laptop automation
execution.admission: pilots + all attempted allocation CPUTimeRAW + outstanding hard reservations + new limits <= the approved limit
execution.cost_reduction: Apply the registered sixty-hour forecast trigger before registration. Any later change to candidates or arms requires a revised registration and approval before tuning; keep all six mazes, twenty seeds and both T=0 controls.

cost_reduction.rationale: Use the previous HER study approval of sixty CPU-hours as the pre-results definition of a large forecast, not as authorization for this study.
applied: Retain only the priority-derived candidate nearest mean acceptance 1/2 per maze and K.
Remove prioritized K=2 from tuning and the final grid; retain both unprioritized controls, every maze and all twenty seeds.
cost_reduction.remaining_rule: If the retained controls and K=4 still exceed sixty hours, request the explicit resulting limit; do not cut mazes, seeds or controls.
